newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips fall as investors take profits.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips fall as investors take profits.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed lower Wednesday as investors took profits and paused to consider the market's next move after a dizzying rise into the record books.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average lost 26.18 points to end at 7,357.23 one day after a record finish of 7,383.41, which was its sixth milestone so far in May and its 21st of the year.
But in the broader market, advancing issues led declines 13-11 on active volume of 491 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
